analysis.title: BorgWarner Inc. (BWA): Mixed 3Q report; Prospect for improving outgrowth in autos and growth in datacenter business key drivers from here
key_insights: GS maintains Buy on BWA with a 12-month price target cut to $78 from $85 (46.3% upside from $53.30). The target uses 12X (from 13X, reflecting lower peer multiples) on unchanged normalized EPS of $6.50.

3Q26 adjusted operating income of $381 mn (10.9% margin) beat GS ($369 mn, 10.7%) and the Street ($372 mn, 10.6%). Operating EPS of $1.39 beat GS ($1.23) by $0.16 and the Street ($1.25) by $0.14. Revenue of $3,487 mn was above GS ($3,464 mn) and about in line with the Street ($3,497 mn).
GS describes the print as relatively solid versus tier 1 auto peers that have already reported, many of which lowered full-year guidance, but more mixed on an absolute basis.

2026 adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $5.20-$5.35 from $5.05-$5.30, driven by share repurchases and a lower full-year effective tax rate. The adjusted operating margin outlook was held at 10.7%-10.9%.

2026 revenue guidance was trimmed to $14.0-$14.2 bn from $14.0-$14.3 bn, and organic growth outlook is now -4.0% to -2.5% from -3.5% to -1.5%. Full-year FCF guidance is unchanged at $900 mn-$1,100 mn.
Implied 4Q26 guidance at the midpoint is below both GS and the Street: revenue $3,432 mn vs GS $3,545 mn and Street $3,521 mn, margin 10.4% vs 10.9%/11.0%, EPS $1.22 vs $1.31/$1.31.

Datacenter/energy products: the turbine generator has strong customer interest with external demonstrations planned in 4Q, and management still expects more than $300 mn of sales next year. GS expects datacenter expansion to be a key growth driver starting in 2027.

The bi-directional microgrid inverter has shipped samples to seven customers and begun quoting with its first major customer, with SOP expected in 2027. BorgWarner also announced a new power supply unit (PSU) product to expand its addressable market. The battery energy storage system (BESS) is in active quoting and expected to be ready for 2027 production.

Auto awards include an engine control module for a global OEM's new ICE pickup platform, three conquest turbocharger awards, a first aluminum-wire eMotor award with a major Chinese OEM for hybrids, and three eMotor awards with Chinese OEMs. Management expects modest outgrowth in 2027 and more meaningful outgrowth in 2028.
Weighted vehicle production assumption for CY26 is now down 2% to down 1% (from down 3% to about flat), with Europe better, offset by weaker China and North America.

Segment detail: PowerDrive Systems revenue was $705 mn vs GS $655 mn (+7.6%) with EBIT of -$5 mn vs GS -$16.4 mn. Turbos & Thermal margin was 14.7% vs GS 15.1%. Drivetrain & Morse revenue was $1,346 mn vs GS $1,375 mn (-2.1%).

GS cut its revenue estimates (2026E $14,118 mn from $14,190 mn; 2027E $14,811 mn from $15,002 mn; 2028E $16,107 mn from $16,301 mn) and moved EPS to $5.30/$5.90/$7.05 from $5.20/$5.95/$7.05, helped by a lower share count.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Buy and lowers the target to $78 from $85 on a lower peer multiple (12X vs 13X). It cites auto awards setting up outgrowth in 2027-2028 and datacenter products as a growth driver from 2027.

earnings_insights: BWA 3Q26 reported 10/29/2026: operating (non-GAAP, adjusted) EPS $1.39 vs GS est $1.23 and Street (FactSet) est $1.25. Adjusted operating income $381 mn (10.9% margin) vs GS est $369 mn and Street est $372 mn. Revenue $3,487 mn vs GS est $3,464 mn and Street est $3,497 mn.

BWA 2026 guidance: adjusted EPS $5.20-$5.35 (raised from $5.05-$5.30; GS prior est $5.20, Street est $5.21). Revenue $14.0-$14.2 bn (prior $14.0-$14.3 bn). Adjusted operating margin 10.7%-10.9% (unchanged). FCF $900 mn-$1,100 mn (unchanged).
Implied 4Q26 guidance at midpoint: revenue $3,432 mn, adjusted operating margin about 10.4%, adjusted EPS $1.22, vs GS prior est $3,545 mn / 10.9% / $1.31 and Street est $3,521 mn / 11.0% / $1.31.
3Q26 FCF was $195 mn, with about $35 mn for dividends and $175 mn for share repurchases. The company reduced gross debt by $864 mn through a debt tender and make-whole redemption.
GS estimates: EPS (diluted, pre-exceptionals) 2026E $5.30, 2027E $5.90, 2028E $7.05. Revenue 2026E $14,118 mn, 2027E $14,811 mn, 2028E $16,107 mn.
risk_factors: Revenue growth and long-term profitability, including exposure to EVs and profits from ICE-related products.
Overall growth of the automotive industry.
